name: ZeyDo
tagline: AI coworkers specialized by profession for businesses
description: ZeyDo presents role-specialized AI coworkers for business teams. Its website lets visitors explore profiles by occupation, industry and activity, and describes agents that work with teams, use business software, communicate with customers and carry out professional missions. The product also describes local, hybrid and cloud deployment, with permissions and approval controls. The company publishes pilot prices from €149 excluding VAT per AI coworker per month; hardware and AI usage are listed separately. These details reflect the current public site and may change. ZeyDo is a product of iAgent Tech in France.
